conflict_handling: Surface the conflict, identify source precedence, preserve disputed evidence, avoid silently selecting a convenient interpretation.

decision_classes.rule: recommend a possible action; no mutation implied
affects external systems, publication, permissions, money, privacy or durable project state; requires explicit authority and stronger evidence

layers.agent: each Naya acts within inherited authority and declared task scope
layers.evidence: verification claims require evidence appropriate to the claim
layers.human: Shawn is final human authority for this environment
layers.system: canonical contracts define allowed states, transitions, scope and proof requirements

promotion_revocation: Knowledge, learning and system changes move through explicit states; promotion requires evidence; revocation overrides stale state; supersession remains traceable.
purpose: The governance model of the activation kit: four governance layers, four decision classes, promotion/revocation, conflict handling, and auditability.
